title: cost-stewardship-multiplexer-heuristics-and-quant-plan-executor
author: Avery Chen
description:
Summary: Adds a tenant-aware microbatch multiplexer (Multiplexer) with a lightweight hedging heuristic and a Quant Plan Executor that selects a safe quantization profile per-request path. The goal is to reduce unit token cost by opportunistic multiplexing + conservative quant plan fallbacks while preserving latency SLOs and end-to-end quality for production traffic. Motivation: Existing defaults favor single-tenant batching and global quant profiles; this change enables multiplexing small requests across tenants (when safe) and dynamically picks quantization plans based on recent unit-econ signals and lightweight per-tenant quality probes. This lets us reclaim idle GPU cycles without manual profile tuning.

Design highlights: - Multiplexer: router component that groups compatible requests into microbatches on the serving runtime. Compatibility uses shape/seq-length, model variant, and a safety fingerprint (prompt type + tenant quality budget). - Hedging heuristic: proactively duplicates only the KV-cache-prefill portion for the fastest microbatch candidate; fallback happens if the preferred path misses quality thresholds. - Quant Plan Executor: runtime hook that evaluates a ranked list of quant plans (e.g., q4_0, q4_1, q3_mixed) and selects the least aggressive plan that satisfies predicted quality margin. Plans are ranked by unit-econ delta and recent regression signal. - Safety fences: tenant-level opt-outs, per-route minimum quality score, and a rollback window for any plan that produces alerting deltas in the Quality Monitor. - Telemetry: new metrics under optimize.multiplexer.* and quant.plan.* for adoption, success_rate, and per-tenant token-econ delta. Also adds an event type (quant_plan_evaluation) to the audit log for Private installs.

Checklist: - [x] Implement multiplexer core + hedging heuristic - [x] Integrate Quant Plan Executor with skyline/econ signals - [x] Add metrics + tracing hooks - [x] Add unit and integration tests for mux + quant selection - [x] Add e2e smoke test in perf-canary harness - [x] Docs stub for Console + Optimize UI - [x] Add Linear links and rollout playbook

Commits (summary): - 1a2b3c4: initial multiplexer scaffold and router tests - 2b3c4d5: hedging heuristic + KV-prefill duplication path - 3c4d5e6: quant plan executor + ranking service adapter - 4d5e6f7: telemetry + audit events - 5e6f7g8: tests and perf-canary scenario + fixes

Files/areas changed (high level): - runtime/multiplexer/* (core router, safety checks, tests) - runtime/kvprefill/hedge_adaptor.go (hedging path hooks) - optimize/quant_executor/* (ranking, plan executor, telemetry) - console/docs/optimize/multiplexer.md (docs stub) - perf-canary/scenarios/multiplexor-smoke.yaml (smoke test) - metrics/metric_registry.yaml (metric additions) - audit/events/quant_plan_evaluation.proto (audit event)

Testing and CI: - Local unit tests added for router compatibility checks and quant ranking (go test). - Integration test in perf-canary runs a synthetic multi-tenant trace; identified and fixed a race in the prefill code. - CI: initial run failed (integration timeout) — increased perf-canary timeout and re-ran; final CI status: PASS. - Perf: microbench against a synthetic steady-state trace showed 7-12% token-cost reduction on mixed workloads with a <3% increase in P95 latency for small requests (guarded by SLO policy). There is a gradual rollout plan tied to Optimize adoption metrics.

Rollout plan (high level): 1) Canary in perf region us-west-2 for a subset of low-risk tenants 2) Shadow mode with cost suggestions to inbox for 2 weeks 3) Gradual enable with tenant-level override console controls 4) Monitor optimize.multiplexer.adoption and quality regression alerts for rollback

Review conversation (excerpt): - Maya Patel (review): "Nice separation between router and executor. Two asks: (1) make the safety fingerprint extensible for future prompt-derived signals, (2) clarify how the hedged prefill affects GPU memory accounting." - Avery Chen (author): "Addressed (1) by adding a fingerprint interface and documented the extension points. For (2) added accounting hooks that decrement hedged-prefill budget on completion; added comment and metric mux.hedge.memory_delta." - Lena Novak (review): "Can we add a unit test that simulates a quant plan causing a small but measurable BLEU/regression? Would prefer explicit test instead of relying purely on smoke harness." - Avery Chen: "Added a new quant-regression unit that uses a tiny labeled prompt set and validates plan selection rejects a plan that drops quality beyond the configured margin." - Ethan Brooks: "LGTM pending CI pass and a minor naming nits." - Ethan Brooks (approval): "Approved" (2026-02-19)

CI timeline: - 2026-02-16T03:12: initial CI run (unit tests passed, integration timed out) - 2026-02-17T01:05: updated timeout and fixed race, re-run CI - 2026-02-18T12:22: perf-canary smoke scenario added - 2026-02-19T09:40: all checks green - 2026-02-20T08:10: merge (squash)

Merge outcome: merged into main via squash. Notes: included a short release note and an Optimize-side migration doc stub; feature will be disabled by default for existing tenants and enabled behind an Optimize experiment flag for early adopters. Related work: ENG-4321 (multiplexor design), ENG-4399 (quant-ranking interface).
release_notes: Introduce tenant-aware microbatch multiplexer with hedging heuristic and a Quant Plan Executor that picks safe quant profiles. Disabled by default; can be enabled via Optimize experiment flag. Adds metrics and audit events.
